when.test: status != null and status != '' and status != 'all'

sql.if: AND ( CAST(id AS CHAR) LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR CAST(task_id AS CHAR) LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR task_name_snapshot LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR requested_by LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR query_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR application_ids LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR job_ids LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )

mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sql_task_execution WHERE task_id = #{taskId}

SELECT id, task_id, task_name_snapshot, sql_snapshot, parameter_schema_snapshot, rendered_sql_snapshot, parameter_values, business_date, source_type, task_version_no, task_revision, status, current_step_no, total_steps, succeeded_steps, failed_step_no, requested_by, executor_instance_id, query_id, application_ids, job_ids, error_message, submitted_at, started_at, finished_at, heartbeat_at, update_time FROM sql_task_execution WHERE task_id = #{taskId}
ORDER BY submitted_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}

SELECT id, task_id, task_name_snapshot, sql_snapshot, parameter_schema_snapshot, rendered_sql_snapshot, parameter_values, business_date, source_type, task_version_no, task_revision, status, current_step_no, total_steps, succeeded_steps, failed_step_no, requested_by, executor_instance_id, query_id, application_ids, job_ids, error_message, submitted_at, started_at, finished_at, heartbeat_at, update_time FROM sql_task_execution WHERE 1 = 1
ORDER BY submitted_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status IN ('PENDING', 'QUEUED', 'RUNNING', 'CANCELLING') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS active, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'SUCCEEDED' AND submitted_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 24 HOUR) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS succeeded24h, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'FAILED' AND submitted_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 24 HOUR) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS failed24h, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'CANCELLED' AND submitted_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 24 HOUR) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS cancelled24h FROM sql_task_execution
mapper.update: UPDATE sql_task_execution SET status = 'FAILED', error_message = #{message}, finished_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING'
